execution_hold: Offline preparation only while OutOfWindow builds. No original-binary access or backend launch in this preparation turn.
purpose: Bind the candidate LoadTableBinary +0x08 on-disk slot without claiming the returned constructor vptr or parser behavior is proven.

supporting_reads: Same fixed file streamed SHA256 before and after
Only PE headers and section table needed to validate source and destination mappings

checks_and_stops: Use the fixed target only. Keep source access read-only; do not load it as a module or use runtime addresses.
Stop on source-evidence hash mismatch, target-hash mismatch, PE architecture/image-base mismatch or unavailable access. A new plan never expands authorization or bypasses per-action approval.
Require the complete 8-byte slot to lie in exactly one file-backed PE section and within SizeOfImage/file bounds; do not read zero-fill virtual tails or assume the old raw offset.
Recompute the slot file offset. Stop and review if it differs from candidate 0x340fe8; do not continue at an inferred alternate location.
Reject zero, out-of-image, non-file-backed, ambiguous or non-executable destination mapping. Record the raw qword and reason; do not dereference it or chase thunks.
Executable section membership establishes only a candidate code address, not a function entry or Deserialize identity.
Compare a successful candidate against already saved same-image exports if present; do not perform a new export-name scan or use 32-bit symbol hints as identity proof.
Verify the fixed target hash after reading. Save a new evidence file without overwriting any earlier evidence.
Do not query the returned address automatically. The post-vptr-write helper's effects still require proof before claiming the actual LoadFile edge.
